bank_complaint.en:
SUBJECT: UPI payment of ₹12,000 debited on 2 Nov 2026 but not credited to beneficiary

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hold account number ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS] with Bharat National Bank.

On 2 Nov 2026, I sent ₹12,000 by UPI through PhonePe to my brother, [BROTHER'S NAME]. The amount was debited from my account. My brother did not receive it. The UPI transaction reference (UTR) is [UTR NUMBER].

I complained verbally to the bank on 5 Nov 2026. I have not received any response. The amount has not been reversed.

Under the RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions, a debited UPI payment to a person that is not credited must be fixed within 1 day (T+1). The deadline was 3 Nov 2026. After that, the bank owes ₹100 for every day of delay, without the customer asking. As of today, 20 Nov 2026, the delay is 17 days, so the compensation due is ₹1,700.

I am making this written complaint as required by the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026. Please share a complaint reference number.

Regards,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]
[EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Reverse ₹12,000 to my account, or credit it to the beneficiary.
2. Pay compensation of ₹1,700 for 17 days of delay, plus ₹100 for each further day until the matter is resolved.
3. Give me a written reply and a complaint reference number.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Bank statement showing the ₹12,000 debit on 2 Nov 2026
- PhonePe transaction screenshot showing the UTR number
- Beneficiary's statement showing no credit (if available)
- Any record of the verbal complaint made on 5 Nov 2026
bank_complaint.hi:
SUBJECT: ₹12,000 का UPI भुगतान खाते से कटा पर प्राप्तकर्ता को नहीं मिला (2 Nov 2026), रिफंड और मुआवज़े हेतु लिखित शिकायत

DESCRIPTION:
महोदय/महोदया,

मेरा नाम [आपका पूरा नाम] है। मेरा Bharat National Bank में खाता है, जिसके अंतिम 4 अंक [खाते के अंतिम 4 अंक] हैं।

2 Nov 2026 को मैंने PhonePe से अपने भाई [भाई का नाम] को ₹12,000 का UPI भुगतान किया। यह राशि मेरे खाते से कट गई, लेकिन मेरे भाई के खाते में जमा नहीं हुई। UPI ट्रांज़ैक्शन ID/UTR: [UPI ट्रांज़ैक्शन ID]।

मैंने 5 Nov 2026 को बैंक में मौखिक शिकायत की थी, पर आज तक कोई जवाब नहीं मिला। राशि भी वापस नहीं आई है।

"RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions" के अनुसार, व्यक्ति को किए गए UPI भुगतान में राशि कटने पर भी जमा न हो, तो उसे 1 दिन (T+1) में ठीक करना होता है। उसके बाद बैंक को बिना माँगे हर दिन की देरी के लिए ₹100 देने होते हैं। मेरे मामले में T+1 की समय-सीमा 3 Nov 2026 थी। 17 दिन की देरी पर मुआवज़ा ₹100 × 17 = ₹1,700 बनता है।

"RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026" के अनुसार, मैं यह शिकायत अब लिखित रूप में दर्ज कर रहा/रही हूँ। कृपया इसकी शिकायत संख्या (reference number) मुझे दें।

धन्यवाद,
[आपका पूरा नाम]
[मोबाइल नंबर]
[ईमेल]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. ₹12,000 की राशि मेरे खाते में तुरंत वापस की जाए या प्राप्तकर्ता के खाते में जमा की जाए।
2. 3 Nov 2026 के बाद की देरी के लिए ₹100 प्रति दिन का मुआवज़ा दिया जाए, जो आज तक ₹1,700 है।
3. इस शिकायत की संख्या और लिखित जवाब दिया जाए।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- PhonePe ट्रांज़ैक्शन का स्क्रीनशॉट (UTR सहित)
- खाते का स्टेटमेंट, जिसमें ₹12,000 का डेबिट दिखे
- 5 Nov 2026 की मौखिक शिकायत का कोई विवरण या प्रमाण (यदि हो)

rbi_ombudsman.en:
SUBJECT: UPI payment of ₹12,000 debited on 2 Nov 2026 but not credited, Bharat National Bank

DESCRIPTION:
I hold an account with Bharat National Bank, ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].

On 2 Nov 2026, I sent ₹12,000 by UPI through PhonePe to my brother, [BROTHER'S NAME]. The UPI transaction ID is [UPI TRANSACTION ID / UTR NUMBER]. The amount was debited from my account. My brother did not receive it. It has not been reversed to me.

On 5 Nov 2026, I complained to the bank verbally. I then complained in writing on [DATE OF WRITTEN COMPLAINT TO BANK]. My complaint reference number is [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. The bank has not replied.

Under RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions, the bank had to fix this failed UPI payment by T+1, that is 3 Nov 2026. After that, it owes me ₹100 for every day of delay, without my asking. As of 20 Nov 2026, this is ₹100 × 17 days = ₹1,700. The amount keeps rising by ₹100 each day until the money is credited.

I am filing under the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026. I ask the Ombudsman to direct the bank to resolve this.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Credit ₹12,000 to my brother's account, or reverse it to my account.
2. Pay me compensation of ₹100 per day of delay after 3 Nov 2026, as required by RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions. This was ₹1,700 as of 20 Nov 2026.
3. Give me a written explanation for the failure and the delay.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Bank statement showing the ₹12,000 debit on 2 Nov 2026
- PhonePe screenshot showing the transaction ID and status
- Copy of my written complaint to the bank, with proof of sending
- Any acknowledgement or reference number from the bank
- My brother's statement showing no credit (if available)

consumer_commission.en:
SUBJECT: Complaint against Bharat National Bank: failed UPI payment of ₹12,000 not reversed

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME]. I hold an account with Bharat National Bank ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS]. On 2 Nov 2026, I sent ₹12,000 by UPI through PhonePe to my brother, [BROTHER'S NAME]. The amount was debited from my account, but my brother did not receive it. The UPI transaction ID is [UPI TRANSACTION ID].

On 5 Nov 2026, I complained to the bank verbally at [BRANCH NAME OR HELPLINE]. I have had no response. As of 20 Nov 2026, the amount has not been reversed.

Under the RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions, the bank had to fix this by T+1, which was 3 Nov 2026. After that, it owes ₹100 for every day of delay, without my asking. For 17 days of delay, this is ₹100 × 17 = ₹1,700 so far. The bank has paid nothing.

I am filing within 2 years of the cause of action, as required by the Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69. The amount paid is ₹12,000. Under the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E), this District Commission hears the case. Under the Consumer commission filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023, the filing fee is nil.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct the bank to reverse ₹12,000 to my account.
2. Direct the bank to pay ₹1,700 in compensation up to 20 Nov 2026.
3. Direct the bank to pay a further ₹100 per day until the amount is reversed.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Bank statement showing the ₹12,000 debit on 2 Nov 2026
- PhonePe screenshot showing the UPI transaction ID
- Proof from my brother that he did not receive the money
- Details of my 5 Nov 2026 complaint, with [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER] if any
- My identity proof
